section.sectionSummaryBrief: This explains that the revelations of the future depend specifically on our service in exile, because true self-nullification is primarily achieved through the service of accepting the yoke during exile.
section.t: And it can be said,
that this is also among the explanations of that which the revelations of the future to come depend specifically on our deeds and service during the time of exile45,
for the essential concept of self-nullification is primarily in the service that is during the time of exile.
For in the self-nullification that existed during the time of the Holy Temple,
since there was then perception of G-dliness and, at their level, even sight of G-dliness46,
the existence of the person who perceived and saw was also felt,
but during the time of exile,
and especially in the generation of the heels of Moshiach,
the service is with the self-nullification of accepting the yoke,
and the self-nullification of accepting the yoke is not from the perspective of the person's existence but from the perspective of G-dliness.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This explains that Moshe's humility was primarily for the generation of the heels of Moshiach, whose service of accepting the yoke and self-sacrifice causes the revelations of the future.
section.t: And this is what is explained in the discourses of our Nesi'im47
in the explanation of the verse48
"And the man Moshe was very humble, more than any man on the face of the earth,"
that primarily this was because of the generation of the heels of Moshiach,
for which concealments and veils are great,
and nevertheless they stand with immense strength and learn Torah and fulfill mitzvos with self-sacrifice,
therefore
(in the language of the discourse49)
Moshe Rabbeinu fell down before them.
For the self-nullification of Moshe,
and "we are nothing"50,
is the self-nullification of the lower unity,
and the service of the generation of the heels of Moshiach is with the self-nullification of accepting the yoke and self-sacrifice,
and self-nullification in existence falls down before the self-nullification of accepting the yoke and self-sacrifice.
And this is that the revelations of the future to come depend specifically on our deeds and service during the time of exile,
for the primary innovation in the revelations of the future to come is that then the superiority of the drawing down of the light of the Unlimited into nature and the physical body will be revealed,
whose self-nullification is not from the perspective of their existence but from the perspective of G-dliness,
and this revelation is through the self-nullification of accepting the yoke and self-sacrifice during the time of exile.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This explains that although the miracles of the future will be greater, the channel opened at the Exodus already contained the future wonders in concealment, as the verse compares them.
section.t: And this):
Now, even though the miracles that were in the Exodus from Egypt were above nature,
and the concept of "I will show him wonders"
[the clothing of miracles in nature and that nevertheless the miracles are revealed]
will be only in the future redemption,
nevertheless,
according to the known principle51
that the opening of the channel of all redemptions,
also of the future redemption,
was in the redemption of the Exodus from Egypt,
it can be said,
that also in the Exodus from Egypt there was the concept of "I will show him wonders."
Except that this concept was then in concealment.
And in the future it will be in revelation.
And this is "As the days of your exodus from the land of Egypt I will show him wonders,"
for the verse compares the wonders that will be in the future redemption to the wonders that were in the Exodus from Egypt,
even though the miracles and wonders of the future redemption will be from Him, blessed be He, alone
(not through His court,
as were the miracles of the Exodus from Egypt)52,
for in the Exodus from Egypt the channel was opened and there were then in concealment also the wonders of the future to come.
